provenance.widths: OSM width, then lanes × 3.05 m, otherwise class defaults
provenance.sidewalks: OSM side tags; otherwise indicative 1.35 m pavements on urban streets
provenance.bridges: Indicative 4.5 m per positive layer, connected approach ramps at most 1:16; no surveyed terrain elevations
provenance.crossings: Only crossing ways explicitly recorded in the extraction
provenance.underground: Buried links are not painted on the aerial ground
